name: Destro
source:
You are a police officer living in destro one of the greatest cities in the country with your best friend.

One day you get assigned your first case, a murder.

But you'll find out as the story progresses that it wasn't just a simple murder...

[From Itch.io]
translation:
你是一名警察，与最好的朋友一起住在德斯特罗——全国最繁华的城市之一。

一天，你接到了自己的第一个案件：一宗谋杀案。

但随着故事推进，你会发现，这远不是一宗普通的谋杀案……

[摘自Itch.io]
